observations.Humpback: Five studio views preserve accepted solid whale form; 15 action samples show roll and independent tail bend. Opaque water Surface frames: submerged start/end, crest reveals knobbly head, dorsal and one pale pectoral, then front slips under. Fluke frames: front submerged while pale vertical flukes lift/hold, descend at fixed XY and disappear. Fixed studio framing deliberately includes the underwater envelope.
observations.BlowSpout: Five views show narrow tapered base and four rounded low-facet opaque ivory/cool-shadow lobes, split V/heart crown in front/back views. 180 triangles. No stacked cubes or cards.
observations.KittiwakeFlock: All five views and five Circle samples show three separate ivory/black/yellow gulls, staggered heights, orbit progression and matching loop endpoint. Flock-wide view deliberately retains space between birds.
observations.BaitBall: Five views show thin solid fish tiles; edge-on thinness intentional. Five Swirl samples show gentle rotational/ripple changes and exact endpoint rather than a fast spin.
observations.Assembly: Both deck45 sizes opened. Whale back/dorsal and ivory breath read clearly, three circling birds remain separated; underwater fish patch is subdued but visible. Phone bait tiles are subtle. Pale pectorals are mostly below water at the breath pose; studio shows their full form. Production water/native scale still needs lead review.

limits: Isolated Blender evidence; no production water, HUD, cast or navigation acceptance.
Explicit Legacy importer and wrap binding required.
Whale anchor depth comparison is point-based, not whole-footprint collision acceptance.
